title: kyllinga brevifolia var. intermedia
intro: Kyllinga brevifolia var. intermedia, commonly known as the short-fruited kyllinga, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Cyperaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of fever, headache, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
